name: Spectator liaison
design: Tall heavy female with tan-copper spots, exposed broad mandible face, long dreadlocks swept behind shoulders with two dark bands. Long charcoal coat with mustard asymmetric front panel and folded cloth collar, narrow bronze shoulder clips, broad belt with a small token pouch. Holds a compact enclosed unlit usher lantern down at one side, other hand makes a restrained welcoming gesture. Full limb silhouette inside frame.
